contracts.source: Ginkgo Bioworks press release: Ginkgo Bioworks to Build an Autonomous Lab at Novo's New (09-15-2026)
contracts.signal: Ginkgo was selected to build an autonomous lab powered by its Reconfigurable Automation Cart (RAC) architecture and Catalyst software at Novo's new R&D site in Waltham, Massachusetts. Novo purchased the lab; Ginkgo says this expands the relationship: Novo had worked with Ginkgo as an external R&D partner and now adds Ginkgo as a provider of the automation tools and software that power its internal laboratories for U.S. R&D.
contracts.units: one autonomous lab (RAC system) at Novo's Waltham, Massachusetts R&D site
